turns.replyText:
How do I use it properly the very first time?

Here’s how to use your Mesa Loop 30oz for the very first time:

Take everything out of the box and remove any inserts or packaging.
Disassemble the lid: take off the straw and remove the silicone plug.
Wash the bottle, lid, straw, and silicone plug with warm, soapy water (or pop them on the top rack of your dishwasher).
Let all parts air dry completely before putting them back together.
When you’re ready to use it, fill with your favorite drink (just not hot liquids if you’re new to using straws—start with cold or room temp!).
Make sure the lid is twisted on tightly and the straw is locked in place.
To drink, just click the button to unlock the lid, flip open the straw, and sip away!

Don’t microwave or freeze it. And always double-check the lid is closed before tossing it in your bag. Enjoy your new tumbler! 😊
